definitions.explanation: The act or method of blocking sound from passing through walls, floors, or other barriers. A technical term used in construction, architecture, and acoustics.

examples.japanese: {遮音|しゃおん}⟦{性能|せいのう}→性能：04340_seinou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦{壁|かべ}→壁：01290_kabe⟧。
examples.english: A wall with high sound insulation performance.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦マンション→マンション：01035_manshon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{遮音|しゃおん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦しっかりしている→しっかりする：21456_shikkarisuru⟧。
examples.english: This apartment building has solid soundproofing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{録音|ろくおん}→録音：05107_rokuon⟧⟦スタジオ→スタジオ：11583_sutajio⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{遮音|しゃおん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{吸音|きゅうおん}→吸音：19206_kyuuon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{両方|りょうほう}→両方：01750_ryouhou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: In a recording studio, both sound insulation and sound absorption are needed.

notes: Composed of {遮|しゃ} (block, intercept) + {音|おん} (sound). Refers specifically to blocking sound transmission, as opposed to ⟦{吸音|きゅうおん}→吸音：19206_kyuuon⟧ (sound absorption, which reduces echo) and ⟦{防音|ぼうおん}→防音：14565_bouon⟧ (soundproofing, the general term). Common collocations: {遮音|しゃおん}⟦{性|せい}→性：09880_sei⟧ (sound insulation properties), {遮音|しゃおん}⟦{材|ざい}→〜材：28347_zai⟧ (sound insulation material), {遮音|しゃおん}⟦{等級|とうきゅう}→等級：28928_toukyuu⟧ (sound insulation rating). An important concept when apartment hunting in Japan — {遮音|しゃおん}⟦{等級|とうきゅう}→等級：28928_toukyuu⟧ ratings indicate how well floors and walls block noise between units.
